caseStudy.water-access-kampala.title: Igiye amazi gihinduka ryo kubahoneza
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.summary: Kumva ibi abaturage batanika ku bijyanye no kubahoneza amazi i Kampala
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.imageAlt: Igihugu cy'imyanda itandukanye ry'amabwi bafite abantu benshi ku musinga w'izuba ryerezwe
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.1: Mu miryango itandukanye i Kampala, kubahoneza amazi bushobora guhinduka ukurikira umunsi n'uwundi. Interrupusi, amazi adafite uburyo bwo kubahoneza neza n'ibibazo by'ubuzimumuzi bw'amazi byashobora gukora nk'urwego ku miryango hashyire uko ari uko abaturage bari banawe n'ubwa serivisi babashobora gukura.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.2: Kunyereza kuri Community Water Watch, WatchTower itanga uburyo bwo kwandika ibi abantu babonyemo mu ndimbo zibafasha, bigafasha ibitekerezo by'umuntu umwe kwinjira mu ishushanyo ry'uruhare rwose rw'ibyo abaturage banyerezwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.3: Nimwe umwe n'akanya tunashobora kunyura iminsi tweze t知道的 nitazobona amazi uzaboneka ryari gute.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.4: Raporo imwe ishobora gufata uburyo bw'umuntu umwe. Ariko iyo raporo nzamone niyo raporo zisa zitandukanye, zitandukanye ahantu n'igihe, zishobora kugaragaza ibintu birenze ibyo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.5: Community Water Watch yarabonetse kugira ngo iyo mahoro yegeranye no kuyifasha ko byumvikana biracyane.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.6: Kumva ibyo imibare ishindiye gushobora kugaragaza
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.7: Amakuru asanzwe ashobora kutugaragaza byinshi ku mushinga w'ububiranyuma na serivisi. Ariko ntacyo gukunda ngo agaragaze ko kubahoneza amazi kutabyumvikanwa kohera mu nzu n'abaturage bigaragara.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.8: Abantu bagaragaza iminsi bitaramo amazi, intera ngendo bafata kugira ngo babone indi nto, impinduka ku buzimumuzi bw'amazi n'uburyo interupusi zicara mu buzima bwa buri munsi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.9: Tanga raporo dza mu miryango byongerera indi tabiri y'ubushingure, imfubyane ku byababone n'abyababona byabo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.10.a: Igihugu cy'imyanda itandukanye ry'amabwi bafite abantu benshi ku musinga w'izuba ryerezwe
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.12: Community Water Watch yashoresheje WatchTower kugira ngo andika raporo byishimye mu ndimbo no mu nto zose.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.13: Kwandika raporo mu ndimbo umuntu azi neza:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.14: Abantu bashobora gutanga raporo mu ndimbo umuntu abyumvise neza, bikababunira gukora imirimo yo guhinda ibyo banyereza mbere yo kubishyira inzira.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.15: Gutanga raporo mu majwi no mu mwandiko:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.16: Raporo zashobora gusangwa hinye na mwandiko cyangwa amajwi, byaba abantu bafite uburyo butandukanye bwo kugaragaza ibibazo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.18: WatchTower yafashije gukandika, guhindura no gutunganya raporo kugira ngo amakuru yatanzwe mu ndimbo zitandukanye ashobora gusobanukirwa hamwe.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.20: Nyuma y'icyo, raporo zashobora kugenzurwa hakurikijwe ahantu, igihe n'ubwoko bw'ibintu byabaye, bigafasha kumenya neza ibintu bigaragara kandi bikora.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.21: Buri bwera mu buryo bwo gukora:
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.22: Amakuru y'umuntu n'aho ari by exact byashobora gukangurwa cyangwa gusangira kugira ngo byifashe abantu batanga raporo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.24: Uko raporo zongerwaga, uburyo bw'abantu bw日开始 bwari bwihuje.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.27: Raporo zatanzwe n'abaturage bari mu nto zose za Kampala, hifashishwa cyane ku kubahoneza amazi, interupusi mu serivisi n'ubuzimumuzi bw'amazi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.29: Kuva ku bishingure kugera ku gukora
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.30: Kumva ntibigira ariko bishimisho kugira ngo ibyo abaturage basangiwe bibashobora gutuma ibisigaye birimo.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.31: Ubushingure bwuzuye kunyereza kuri Community Water Watch bushobora kugira ngo ingamba zitandukanye: hagati y'abaturage, organisasi n'abandi bafitanye uruhare, aho bakora ibijyanye no kubahoneza amazi.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.32: Raporo zashobora gutanga ibindi nyungurukire ku kuganira, gushinja ibintu, guteza imigambi mu bikorwa, guhuza ibikorwa no kurwanya ibabare.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.34: Abantu bari hafi n'aho ikitabaye giherawe banzi ko birangwanye n'uburyo ibintu byakozwe ndetse n'imibare y'ukuruuriya gusa ntishobora kugaragaza.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.35: Gutanga raporo mu miryango gutanga uburyo bwo gufata ibyo mahoro nk'akabuka.
caseStudy.water-access-kampala.body.36: Igihe umuntu ashobora kwandika raporo mu ndimbo ze, kandi raporo zo zashobora gusobanukirwa, guhuza no kugenzurwa hamwe, amajwi y'abantu yashobora gusa ku byasobanura neza ibibera ku butaka.
caseStudy.changing-seasons-everyday-life: Igihe ibinyabiziga bigahindura buzima bwa buri munsi
Uko amajwi y'abaturage arashobora gufasha gushyira mu buryo butandukanye ibyo ibintu bitandukanira mu muryango.
Amazu asunika ibara ry'amabare ahantu hejuru y'umusozi
